## Review checklist

- [ ] Change matches the issue and committed/stretch milestone scope.
- [ ] Generated outputs were regenerated from canonical sources, if affected.
- [ ] Authorization and cross-company cases were covered, if affected.
- [ ] Relevant contract and design-system reviewers are identified.
- [ ] At least one new valid session log is included, following root SESSION.md; each work session is recorded, and a session may span multiple commits.
- [ ] Remaining work and unresolved decisions are explicit.
